t: A free guide with 13 unplugged coding activities for grades K-5.
steps: Find the Kodable unplugged coding activities guide online.
Print the worksheet pack for your grade band.
Gather simple materials such as paper, origami paper, string, and beads.
Pick one short activity, such as Code a Friend.
Run the activity and keep time.
Choose a capstone if your class is grade 3 or older.
